Initial release of webclaw: a browser-based dashboard for OpenClaw.

- Provides a secure web admin UI for all installed skills with schema-driven rendering.
- Supports JWT authentication, RBAC, rate limiting, audit logging, and HTTPS via Let's Encrypt.
- Includes user, session, and SSL management actions, plus an AI chat module.
- Real-time updates and generic UI components (forms, tables, charts, etc.) with zero per-skill custom code.
- First-use setup flow and comprehensive command/action documentation included.
